basic_info.description: Situated in the heart of one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods, this enchanting Edwardian condominium in Alamo Square offers a blend of classic charm and modern convenience. The entire unit is light and airy, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. The home features two serene bedrooms, including a primary suite that boasts a huge cedar-lined closet and windows looking out to verdant trees, offering both ample storage and a soothing view. The beautifully appointed kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with stainless steel appliances, sleek quartz countertops, ample cabinet space, and generous counter space perfect for preparing gourmet meals.  The expansive living room, with windows framing lush greenery, provides a tranquil retreat to unwind. Additional features include new windows that enhance the home's brightness and an in-unit washer and dryer for ultimate convenience. Set on the quieter side of the building, this residence includes abundant closet space, a spacious storage room, and access to a peaceful shared garden.  Located in a charming six-unit boutique building with low HOA fees, this home offers a unique sense of community and affordability. Step outside to discover a culinary paradise, with an array of nearby restaurants, cafes, and bars.
